name: Shin-Okachimachi
tagline: Tokyo in 11 minutes and Otemachi in 16 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥120,000 to ¥130,000.
summary: The station is in Taito City, served by Toei Oedo Line and Tsukuba Express. Journey times to the main business districts are 16 minutes to Otemachi, 25 minutes to Shinjuku, 32 minutes to Shibuya and 26 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥120,000 to ¥130,000. The station stands 2.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 0.6 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 2.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 1.9 m to 2.5 m, a difference of 0.6 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 9 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 3 to 5 m. For storm surge, 9 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 51 clinics and 63 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at ライフ・エクステンション研究所付属永寿総合病院, about 366 m away and 全仁会上野病院, about 539 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Toei Oedo Line and Tsukuba Express. The lines are split between operators (the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 1 line and Tsukuba Express runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 57.

rentRange.note: One room ¥120,000 to ¥130,000, 1K ¥130,000 to ¥140,000, 1LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000 and 2LDK ¥250,000 to ¥260,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 30 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively many of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
